Package com.signalwire.sdk.rest

Class HttpClient

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.rest.HttpClient
public class HttpClient extends Object
HTTP client for the SignalWire REST API.

Uses java.net.http.HttpClient (JDK 11+ built-in) with Basic Auth and JSON content types. Provides low-level GET, POST, PUT, DELETE methods used by CrudResource and namespace classes.

  • Method Details

    • withBaseUrl

      public static HttpClient withBaseUrl(String baseUrl, String project, String token)
      Create an HTTP client with an explicit base URL (e.g., plain HTTP for local integration tests, or to point a RestClient at an audit fixture). Production callers use the (space, project, token) constructor instead.
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - fully qualified base URL ending in /api
      project - project ID used as Basic Auth username
      token - API token used as Basic Auth password
      Returns:
      a configured HTTP client
